description: Parse a commit message's trailer block (Co-authored-by, Signed-off-by, Fixes, Reviewed-by, etc.) per git's RFC 822-style trailer convention (git-interpret-trailers): the last paragraph of the message, where every line is either a "Key: value" pair or an indented continuation of the previous trailer's value. Returns the trailers plus the message body with the trailer block removed.
name: parse_commit_trailers
